correctness.rationale: The capped distance is a metric by subadditivity of the cap. Subtracting the constant r^p leaves -r^p at the origin and corrections j^p-r^p for 1≤j<r; a nonzero Walsh character annihilates the constant. Its eigenvalue is therefore exactly (1), and the nontrivial characters span the mean-zero subspace. For fixed degree j the generating function with z=u/√n and t=(n-2k)/√n converges uniformly on compact sets to exp(tu-u²/2); coefficient comparison gives H_j(t)/j!, and only degree 2m survives the n^m normalization on bounded t. For |s|≥R√n, dividing the Krawtchouk recurrence by s^{j+1} gives K_j/s^j=1/j!+O_m(n/s²) for each fixed j. Thus K_{2m} is positive and ≥c_m s^{2m} there for large R; its coefficient stays strictly negative as p→0 and dominates the lower powers uniformly. The compact mesh then yields the positive maximum constant because the nonzero even Hermite polynomial has Gaussian mean zero and positive leading coefficient. Bernstein subordination makes the CND range an initial interval, so the signs at (C_m^{-1}±δ)n^{-m} trap the supremum. Continuity and finiteness yield an attained zero of a nontrivial mode; the same uniform estimates apply with p=β as β→0, forcing its rescaled frequency to approach the minimizer set. Extrema of H4 and H6 confirm both explicit constants. Symbolic replay: python /workspace/audit_evidence/reconstruct.py (hermite_constants); this tests only the low-degree arithmetic, not the limit.
residual_risks: Fixed odd cap only; no increasing-cap regime, unique finite-size maximizing frequency, or assertion that both limiting signs must be attained.
